_comment: The multi-model comparison matrix (owner's list, 2026-09-22). One entry = one run folder.
`model` is the provider-qualified string for LITSENSE_MODEL (OpenRouter through the
OpenAI-compatible provider). `reasoning` is Settings.reasoning_effort: null = send
nothing (provider default), 'none' = switch reasoning off explicitly, otherwise the
effort level requested. Per-model facts come from OpenRouter's /api/v1/models
`reasoning` block on 2026-09-22 and are recorded in `note` where they forced a choice.
The judge is fixed across the matrix (scripts/run_model_matrix.py --judge-model).
`provider_order` (optional, OpenRouter) pins open-weight models to upstream providers that
honour both the JSON-schema response format and reasoning: DeepSeek V4 is served by ~16
providers, some answered the 2026-09-22 smoke test in prose / malformed JSON, and the
tool-call route (NextBit) drops reasoning. Alibaba/DeepInfra did both correctly in probes.

models.label: claude-haiku-4-5
models.note: OpenRouter exposes no effort selection for this model; provider default (no thinking).

models.label: claude-opus-4-8
models.note: default_enabled=false on OpenRouter; 'none' makes the off state explicit.

models.label: deepseek-v4-flash_reasoning_medium
models.note: OpenRouter lists supported_efforts [xhigh, high] for DeepSeek V4 but accepted 'medium' in the 2026-09-22 smoke test (reasoning tokens reported); what was sent is in the run manifest.

models.label: gemini-3.5-flash
models.note: Reasoning is MANDATORY on gemini-3.5-flash (cannot be switched off; default medium). 'minimal' is the closest thing to a no-reasoning run.

models.label: glm-5.2
models.note: Reasoning is ON by default for glm-5.2 (default_effort high); 'none' switches it off so the label means what it says.
